positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Our mission is to create a world where work empowers a better life.

We’re making the most complicated, impersonal business tasks simple and personal. Imagine payroll that brings everyone peace of mind, HR that transforms work into a community, and benefits that help people plan for a better future. That’s what we’re building at Gusto.

To learn more about life at Gusto, visit gusto.com/careers. We’re hiring in San Francisco and Denver!

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
Simple Life transforms Insurance Carriers and General Agencies into technology-first companies. 

We reconstructed policy transactions from quoting to renewal. Our APIs, User Interface (UI), and Structured Workflows transcend traditional entities (carriers, agents, HR) and departments (underwriting, sales, enrollment) to create a powerful foundation for integration, automation, and distribution.

Leverage our APIs

-Empower your distribution partners to delight your customers. -Automate member and employer data exchange
-Advance your API roadmap by years. Deliver modern UI / UX internally and to customers -Revolutionize new business submissions with one simple flow.
-Drive persistency and revenue with automated renewals and blazing fast cross-selling.
-Real-time member engagement and self-service. 

Automate Administration and Underwriting

-Dynamically update underwriting requirements.
-Massively reduce group setup and administration costs.
-Digitize your product from quoting to renewals.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintain and extend the server-side infrastructure and platform (APIs, deployment, monitoring, etc.) servicing multiple mobile/tv apps for various publishers in the comics industry (IDW, Archie Comics, Ovni Press, and more). 
Technologies used: Oauth2, SQS, SNS, S3, ELB, EC2, Cloudfront, Cloudwatch, IAM, Redshift, MySQL, Memcached, Elastic Transcoder, HTTP Live Streaming (HLS), and more.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed APIs for mobile/web game clients. Implemented many features in the game client (using Adobe Air). Areas of familiarity include: 
social features such as Facebook login, achievements
player stats, AB testing, user segmentation, slot game logic, tournaments, internationalization, and more.
Technologies used: ELB, EC2, MySQL, Memcached, mongodb, redis, and more.

positions.title: Patent Examiner
positions.description: Examine patent applications involving electrosurgical probes and thermal ablation systems.

honors.description:
Multiplayer HTML5 game where the objective is to hit gems to collect payouts before the other player hits the gem first.

honors.title: 1st Place BeMyApp Mobile Game Hackathon SF 2013
honors.description:
The BeMyApp WorldCup hackathon is dedicated to innovative mobile games and will take place in Berlin, San Francisco and Paris simultaneously.

- Roughly 400 people came to the opening night in San Francisco, Berlin, and Paris
- Over 80 game ideas were pitched
- More than 30 projects were voted in and built over the course of the weekend in all three cities
- 3 finalists were nominated by a a panel of judges in each city

http://worldcup.bemyapp.com/?p=47
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BDSmsvYWEfY

volunteerExperiences.description: I volunteered at a medical clinic in Dakar, Senegal. I was able to help out in the pharmacy, assist with prenatal care, explain how to use various medications, perform vaccinations, and clean / bandage wounds.
Teach kids K-3 how to read in the Growing Readers program.
